Recorded claim:
Planning integration anchors: load by `cal.manager.getCalendarById(calendarId)` then `await calendar.getItem(eventId)`; create with `CalAddTransaction`, edit/move with `CalModifyTransaction`, delete with `CalDeleteTransaction`, and commit through `CalTransactionManager.getInstance().commit(transaction)`. For M5–M8 retain exact source-backed calls for location, join-link extraction, address-book/LDAP autocomplete, attendees, descriptions, attachments, alarms, categories, `TRANSP`, privacy, recurrence deletion, and memory-calendar observer tests.
